item.title: Orioles’ Craig Albernaz ‘couldn’t sleep’ after Gunnar Henderson’s WBC performance
item.description: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz said he was "fired up" after Gunnar Henderson's four-hit performance for Team USA in the WBC on Saturday.

item.title: Kansas City airport reopens hours after an evacuation as a potential threat was investigated
item.description: KANSAS CITY (AP) — Portions of Kansas City International Airport were being evacuated Sunday afternoon as authorities looked into a potential threat, the Kansas City Aviation Department said. item.description: Do Maryland state and city leaders provide enough transparency about taxpayer spending? Vote in our reader poll on government accountability and oversight.

item.title: The 14th St. Patricks Parade in Annapolis | PHOTOS
item.description: The 14th St. Patrick’s Parade kicked off Sunday afternoon on a new route, starting on West Street at Amos Garrett Blvd. From there, the parade made its way toward downtown on West Street, traveling around Church Circle before continuing down Northwest Street to Calvert concluding on St. John’s Street. For more photos go to capitalgazette.com

item.title: Orioles observations on Tyler Wells the reliever and a young OF’s ‘potential’
item.description: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz has a "Swiss Army knife" in his bullpen with Tyler Wells — a role Wells is "taking pride" in being ready to execute.

item.title: Boston U. defeats Navy men’s basketball Patriot League semifinal | PHOTOS
item.description: The visiting Boston University Terriers defeat the Navy Midshipmen, 73-72, to win a Patriot League Men’s Basketball Championship semifinal game Sunday at Alumni Hall in Annapolis.

item.title: Maryland basketball closes worst regular season in decades with another loss
item.description: Maryland men's basketball's worst regular season since 1988-89 came to a fitting finish Sunday with a 78-72 home loss to No. 11 Illinois.

item.title: Navy men’s basketball stunned by Boston U on last-second shot in Patriot League semifinal
item.description: The madness of March came for Navy on Sunday, as Boston University stunned the Mids on a buzzer-beating 3-pointer in a Patriot League Tournament semifinal.
